title: The Cyclospora Outbreak Was a Warning: Q&A with Saskia Popescu
summary_en: Saskia Popescu is an epidemiologist by training and a policy researcher at RAND. In this Q&A, she discusses what the United States can do to prepare for future outbreaks like Cyclospora and other biological threats.
